settings.hero_text: Handcrafted wood furniture shaped by nature, made to become part of your story.
settings.hero_image_alt: Sculptural handcrafted natural wood furniture in a warm gallery-like living room
settings.story_intro: In a world shaped by speed and repetition, furniture was becoming increasingly uniform—designed to look the same, made quickly, and replaced just as easily.
settings.story_statement_one: Natural curves were straightened. Variations were concealed. Distinctive grain was covered in pursuit of uniformity.
settings.story_statement_two: We saw something different: character shaped by time, growth, and nature itself.
settings.story_image_alt: A handcrafted natural wood table and shelving in a warm, sunlit interior
settings.purpose_statement_one: WRYDECO was born from a desire to slow the process down and create with greater intention.
settings.purpose_statement_two: We let the material guide the form, allowing skilled hands to shape furniture with character, purpose, and lasting presence.
settings.purpose_image_alt: WRYDECO artisans shaping a sculptural natural wood table in the workshop

settings.mission_intro: We create fewer pieces so each one can hold greater meaning, stronger craftsmanship, and lasting presence.
settings.design_text: We start with the soul of the material—its grain, strength, and story—allowing each piece to take shape naturally. Our role is to respect, refine, and reveal its purpose.
settings.design_image_one_alt: Close view of expressive natural wood grain and a live edge
settings.design_image_two_alt: Sculptural handcrafted wood furniture with flowing organic curves
settings.design_image_three_alt: Furniture design sketchbook with material sample and pencil
settings.design_image_four_alt: Finished natural wood coffee table in a warm interior
settings.craft_text: Each WRYDECO piece is crafted in Vietnam by artisans who understand the curve, proportion, surface, and singular character of solid wood.
settings.craft_image_alt: Vietnamese artisans hand-finishing a sculptural solid wood table in the WRYDECO workshop
settings.cta_text: Have a question or a project in mind? We’d love to hear from you.

settings.heading: Respect the Material
settings.text: Preserving the grain, form, and natural character of solid wood.

settings.heading: Honor the Craft
settings.text: Giving skilled hands the time and freedom to shape every detail.

settings.heading: Create for the Long Term
settings.text: Designing furniture to be lived with, cared for, and passed forward.
